Ground-floor-entrance (townhouse-style) units: 1.5 per 1-BR, 2 per 2-BR+. Low/moderate-income or elderly: 1 per unit. Single-family (1.100): 2 per unit plus 1 per rented room. Table is a presumption and can be flexibly administered.
